name: Haka no Rensa ni Torawareta Shojo
original_name: 破瓜の連鎖に捕らわれた処女
source:
* If you could live the same day over and over what would you do? * 

"Get off me, creep!" 

( Don't lie! You were into it, 
you're wet as an otter down there! 
I'm not a molester! 
I'm, I'm---!! ) 

I leaped from the train. Blackness. 
When I woke up--- It was morning the same day. 

Am I reliving the same day over again? 
If so--- what happened before doesn't matter! 
That girl tried to destroy my life. She'll live to regret it!! 

* On the train, in the toilet, at the park and school! 
R*pe the girl who falsely accused you until she's a vision of despair! 

* Take her ever-looping virginity! 
Life is an endless repeat of the same day. Penetrate her hymen 
over and again for the first time, every time! 

* Revenge comes in many flavors! 
Do her little sister while she watches, too!!! 

* Consequences nothing! 
In this strange limbo, pregnancy is no problem!

* 如果你可以一遍又一遍地过同一天，你会做什么？* 

“从我身上下来，混蛋！” 

（别撒谎！你很喜欢，
你下面像水獭一样湿透了！
我不是猥亵者！
我我我——！！）我从火车上跳了下来。黑。
当我醒来时——已经是当天的早晨了。

我是否又重温了同一天？
如果是的话——之前发生的事情都无关紧要了！
那个女孩试图毁掉我的生活。她会后悔一辈子的！！

* 在火车上、厕所里、公园里和学校里！
强奸那个诬告你的女孩，直到她变成绝望的幻象！

*夺走她永远的童贞！
人生就是同一天的不断重复。刺穿她的处女膜 
一次又一次，第一次，每一次！

* 复仇有多种形式！
当她看着的时候，也做她的小妹妹！

* 没有任何后果！
在这种奇怪的状态下，怀孕是没有问题的！
